BCDR & Safety Manager - DV Cleared

12/11/2026
LA International Computer Consultants Ltd
BCDR & Safety Manager Must have an Active DV Clearance - Work closely with technical teams, suppliers and Government stakeholders to maintain operational resilience and regulatory compliance. BCDR & Safety Manager Responsibilities - Develop and maintain Business Continuity Plans (BCPs), Disaster Recovery Plans (DRPs), recovery runbooks and escalation procedures. - Coordinate Business Impact Analysis (BIA), identifying critical services, recovery priorities and dependencies. - Plan and manage disaster recovery exercises across infrastructure, networks, storage, backup, identity and applications. - Validate recovery readiness, including backup, replication and restoration following cyber incidents. - Monitor RTOs, RPOs, recovery dependencies and resilience risks. - Maintain safety documentation, risk assessments, Safety Data Sheets (SDS) and supporting assurance evidence. - Support customer safety case development, reviews and approval submissions. - Develop and maintain sustainability plans covering carbon reduction, single-use plastics and hazardous substances. - Coordinate safety and environmental compliance activities, audits and corrective actions. - Manage incident and near-miss reporting, lessons learned and improvement activities. - Maintain governance reporting, risk registers, remediation plans and audit-ready documentation. - Review service changes for impacts on business continuity, disaster recovery and safety. - Coordinate stakeholders, suppliers and technical teams to resolve risks and maintain compliance. - Submit plans and assurance evidence for customer approval. BCDR & Safety Manager Skills and Experience - Proven Business Continuity, Disaster Recovery or operational resilience management experience. - Experience developing BCPs, DRPs and coordinating recovery exercises. - Strong understanding of Business Impact Analysis, RTOs, RPOs and recovery dependencies. - Experience coordinating technical recovery across complex IT infrastructure environments. - Strong knowledge of ITIL processes, including Incident, Problem, Change and Configuration Management. - Experience in Safety and Environmental Management within IT services, Defence or critical infrastructure. - Knowledge of safety documentation, risk assessments, Safety Data Sheets and safety case assurance. - Experience supporting environmental compliance, sustainability planning and performance reporting. - Strong governance, risk management, audit and regulatory compliance experience. - Excellent stakeholder management, communication and technical documentation skills. - Experience supporting secure Government, Defence or critical infrastructure environments would be advantageous. - CBCI, MBCI or ISO 22301 qualifications would be desirable. - ITIL 4 certification and knowledge of resilience management frameworks would be beneficial. - NEBOSH or IEMA qualifications would be advantageous. - Knowledge of ISO 14001, ISO 45001, JSP 815 or JSP 816 would be desirable. - Understanding of COSHH, REACH, carbon reporting and hazardous substance management would be beneficial. - Experience supporting crisis management and cloud or hybrid disaster recovery would be advantageous. Specific tasks will include: First line support for users both in person and via support channels. Resolve or escalate issues Hardware setup and configuration, patching and upgrades Support audio-visual / conference room equipment and printers Monitoring and maintaining local networking equipment such as access points, firewalls etc Responsible for maintenance and upkeep of our backup Infrastructure, including laptops and relevant server(s) and other designated cloud backup locations. Provide timely report to senior management on progress of dedicated tasks, or on-going activities. Configuration and monitoring of core systems Administration for IT processes such as: Support ticketing Equipment inventories Hardware purchases, repairs and disposals Joiner-Mover-Leaver process Managing license count Assisting with change projects such as data migration, office reconfiguration and platform or service changes Personal Attributes: Detail and precision in aspects of approach to tasks Ability to prioritise conflicting workflows Team player, ability to communicate effectively with non-technical users and senior management Excellent presentation and time keeping Experience 3 years experience in equivalent setting Microsoft Office 2019+ support essential Mac (iOS) support exposure desirable Exposure to endpoint device management systems desirable S Azure support essential Good documentation and analytical skills, with a passion for end-user satisfaction. Evidence of commitment to training and knowledge The Client is based in Central London with some attendance at operating business offices elsewhere in London and across the UK.
